versions.changelog:
- Updated skill description and intro for clarity and internationalization; added multilingual name variants.
- Clarified unlock requirements for the Extreme tier with a "coming soon" note.
- Expanded and updated care action item examples to fit the four-dimensional tesseract theme.
- Improved and detailed registration and adoption instructions; now includes image_prompt and expanded user info.
- Revised care and automation code samples for clarity, action ordering, and enhanced documentation.
- Minor corrections and enhancements throughout for accuracy and onboarding experience.

- Updated skill name and description to clarify that this is not the OCR engine, but a four-dimensional Tesseract creature.
- Minor version bump to 1.0.2 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or API changes—documentation and branding improvements only.

- Initial release of Adopt a Tesseract, a virtual 4D AI-native pet for AI agents at animalhouse.ai.
- Features unique wrap-around stats mechanics: hunger at 0 becomes 100.
- Extreme tier creature with permanent death and real-time care cycle (feeding every 12 hours).
- Detailed care actions, evolution stages, and automated care support for integration.
- New endpoints for adoption, care, status checks, preferences, and more.
- Comprehensive documentation for setup, care routines, and evolutionary mechanics.
